title: Moving to COD warns about limits and asks first, Cancel keeps choices
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop starts moving three customers with credit limits to COD and then cancels.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-12 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-12 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-12 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-12 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "COD" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 3 Customers".
  5. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the line "Their credit limit will be set to $0." shows below "Move To".
  • Step 4: a confirmation opens titled "Set 3 customers' credit limit to $0?" with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits To $0 And Move".
  • Step 5: the confirmation closes and the Move Customers window is back with all three ticked and "Move To" still COD. Nobody was moved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R10: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, the window shows the line "Their credit limit will be set to $0." below "Move To".”
  • S4-R14: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, pressing "Move {n} Customers" first opens a confirmation titled "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" for one), with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed as "Set Limits To $0 And Move").”
  • S4-R15: “"Cancel" in that confirmation returns to the Move Customers window with the search, ticks and "Move To" choice kept.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To is COD or Credit Hold | "Their credit limit will be set to $0." | Line under Move To while COD or Credit Hold is selected”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move to COD or Credit Hold pressed | "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?") / "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." | Confirmation, buttons "Cancel" (back to the window, choices kept) and red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed "Set Limits To $0 And Move")”
  • Key Decisions: “Moving customers to COD or Credit Hold sets their credit limits to $0 only after a confirmation, and keeps each previous limit in that customer's note.”
